problem: Small real-world imitation datasets often fail under disturbances; synthetic scenes need geometry, articulation and transfer procedures that preserve real task structure.
contribution: RialTo reconstructs real scenes, transfers a visualpolicy into privileged simulation through inverse distillation, robustifies withRL and distills back to deployable perception while co-training realdata.
algorithm: Scan/cut/annotate scene geometry and articulation; train a visualpolicy from about15real demonstrations; execute it in simulation to collect successful state-labelled trajectories; bootstrapPPOwith imitationloss; distill the robust statepolicy to sensoryobservations plus original realdata.
observations: Real/student point-cloud observations and robot state; simulationRLuses privileged object/joint poses. Privileged state is discarded from the deployable sensorypolicy.
actions: Robot end-effector controls under the simulator/robot controllercontract; observation/action trajectories are preserved across the inverse-distillationstage.
embodiment_and_data: Real reconstructed rigid/articulated scenes and manipulation tasks including shelf placement and in-the-wild household interactions; not a validated deformable-sock model.
experiments: Compare original imitation to reconstructed-sceneRLrobustification, distractortraining, inverse-distillation choices and nonexpert reconstruction workflow; evaluate physical taskoutcomes rather than geometryscreenshots.
baselines: Real-world imitation and pipeline/component ablations, including training with or without distractors and alternative supervision sources.
limitations: Geometry needs manual articulation/physics annotation; reconstruction does not measure everydynamic parameter. The paper studies mostly quasistatic rigid scenes and reports roughly2days end-to-end training pertask, a bottleneck for continuallearning. Exactdynamics matter more for fastcontact/deformables.
hardware_adaptation: Reuse the conceptual realgeometry→simulation→perceptionparity approach, preserving measured versus estimated modelparameters. Existing CAD can support anengineeringpilot, but does not validate contactphysics or a socktask. Avoid promising thefulloriginalstack onNX.
algorithm_detail: Inverse distillation executes the real visualpolicy in simulation where privilegedstate is available, producing paired sensory/state demonstrations without inventing real stateobservations. Sparse-rewardRLplusBCloss constrains exploration before a second sensorydistillation with realdata co-training.
integration_contract: Hash scene assets, transforms, articulation and estimatedphysicalparameters; separate real/sim/deriveddataset lineage. Freeze deployable observationfeatures and reject any worldstate leakage. Record reconstruction uncertainty anddistillation/executor mismatches.
license_evidence: Official repository identity/head verified; GitHub metadata returns no recognizedlicense. Do not infer reusepermission from publicvisibility. Copied code requires license clarification or an independent attributedimplementation.
required_experiments: Asset/hash andkinematicchecks; perturbation-controlledsimrollouts; state-to-visualindependent eval; realdata/simdata ablation; resourceprofiling; separate physicalvalidation of contactanddeformables afteroperatorapproval.
difference_from_explorer: Digitaltwins andreal→sim→real robustification alreadyexist. Explorer must measure a new evidence-grounded selection/adaptation/retention rule rather than rename thispipeline.
